name: upc-track
description: UpcTrack - monitoreo de buses UPC Aguachica (monorepo: frontend, backend, database)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend --if-present
